$comment: Pinned commits so a benchmark run measures TestPilot changes, not upstream churn — the runner refuses to diff when a pin moves. Sparse patterns are non-cone (gitignore-style) and every one must match something: a dead pattern silently shrinks the corpus. Check out every directory the repo's Playwright config declares as a test root, or the benchmark manufactures the missing-root warning it exists to detect.

repos.name: cal.com
repos.note: projects[] with RegExp testMatch; the most test-id-driven suite in the corpus.

repos.name: immich
repos.note: Playwright config lives in e2e/, RegExp testMatch, *.e2e-spec.ts naming.

repos.name: Ghost
repos.note: Page objects under e2e/helpers hold most of the locators, and Playwright's testMatch does not run them — so Ghost's high grade is a measure of what Playwright executes, not of the suite's locator quality. It is the corpus's standing argument for Phase 9c.

repos.name: documenso
repos.note: High getByRole adoption — the control for 'does the score reward good practice'. Run from the package that owns the suite, as its own contributors would — its Playwright config is two levels down, past the one-level lookup.

repos.name: mattermost
repos.note: Largest suite; the runtime and false-positive volume check. No root package.json upstream, so it is measured from the package that owns the suite, as its contributors do.
